description: Dataset must contain zero forbidden trading columns (target, label, prediction, buy, sell, etc.).
Candidate states must strictly be research annotation preparation, not supervised learning targets.
Zero raw news article bodies, html scrapings, or full texts stored.
Zero vector database or embedding generation dependencies.
Zero algorithm fit, transform, predict, or clustering operations executed.
Source dataframes must never be mutated, deleted, or overwritten.
Zero automated destructive cleaning, imputation, or feature dropping.
Candidate states must link to explicit Phase 121 validation and Phase 123 quality audits.
